customManagers.description: A version pinned in a package's source, marked by a `// renovate:` line above it: the copier plx runs.

packageRules.description: Outside the weekly group, waiting for a human: the copier plx runs changes how every consumer takes a train (PLX-CLI), and the actions run in tenant CI next to its secrets while a train's pull request shows only their ref, not their code.

The actions' patch, minor and digest updates still wait for a human, but arrive together once a week in a pull request of their own, the same morning as the weekly group; a major still comes on its own.
